assembly: copy and restore SP: mov rax,rsp; mov rsp,rax
LEA alias and restore SP: lea rax,[rsp-16]; mov rsp,rax; add rsp,16
LEA alias to LEA SP: lea rax,[rsp-16]; lea rsp,[rax+16]
copy alias and compare SP: mov rax,rsp; mov rcx,rax; cmp rcx,rsp
alias load: lea rax,[rsp-16]; mov rdx,[rax]
alias store: lea rax,[rsp-16]; mov DWORD PTR [rax],ecx
alias LEA chain: lea rax,[rsp-16]; lea rdx,[rax+8]
alias self copy: lea rax,[rsp-16]; mov rax,rax
alias scalar add: mov rax,rsp; add rax,16
alias scalar subtract: mov rax,rsp; sub rax,16
full spill and restore SP: lea rax,[rsp-16]; mov [rsp-8],rax; mov rax,[rsp-8]; mov rsp,rax; add rsp,16
alias PUSH POP: mov rax,rsp; push rax; pop rax
alias PUSHW POPW: mov rax,rsp; push ax; pop dx
alias partial write al: mov rax,rsp; mov al,1
alias partial write ah: mov rax,rsp; mov ah,1
alias partial write ax: mov rax,rsp; mov ax,1
alias partial write eax: mov rax,rsp; mov eax,1
alias partial add al: mov rax,rsp; add al,1
alias partial add ah: mov rax,rsp; add ah,1
alias partial add ax: mov rax,rsp; add ax,1
alias partial add eax: mov rax,rsp; add eax,1
alias spill BYTE: mov rax,rsp; mov BYTE PTR [rsp-16],al; movzx edx,BYTE PTR [rsp-16]
alias spill WORD: mov rax,rsp; mov WORD PTR [rsp-16],ax; movzx edx,WORD PTR [rsp-16]
alias spill DWORD: mov rax,rsp; mov DWORD PTR [rsp-16],eax; mov edx,DWORD PTR [rsp-16]
alias spill QWORD: mov rax,rsp; mov QWORD PTR [rsp-16],rax; mov rdx,QWORD PTR [rsp-16]
